The '''Tora Harad''' was an exceptionally strong fortress known for its ability of withstand a siege.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Tora Harad}} Its strength rivalled the [[Stone of Tear]] in its formidability.{{Verify}}

Little is known of this fortress other than from Mat's memories of ancient times. It existed and presumably no longer exists today. [[Mat Cauthon]] recalled the Tora Harad whilst comparing its strength to that of [[Cold Rocks Hold]] in the [[Aiel Waste]].{{ref/book|4|49}} It is not known if there is a link between the Tora Harad and [[Harad Dakar]], the long-fallen capital of [[Hardan]].
